narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -6.07 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 80.722-82.071 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 82.369; the first objective pays 0.86R at 80.283.

plan.triggerRule: footprint exh fired sell in short direction at the zone (absorption inside the zone)
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 82.369 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 0.86 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk
